v2_10_19.why: BENCH FLAW found 10-19 (SM4 restart agent): the leaf tb drew the static straps st at random, so the BF16 x field group xs_g2 (and possibly xs_g1) was >= NBEAT=13 at the default seed and the field was NEVER written; the x preload also wrote only 2 of 13 beats per address. Every BF16 x element was 0, every BF16 product +-0 (signed zero canonicalises) -> BF16-column results were all 0 and a sign-inverted BF16 weight copy (new MUT 4) PASSED. The v1 'bit-exact' verdicts above therefore covered the block-dot column only. Fix (tb): valid straps (groups < 12), ALL 13 beats preloaded per address and lane, BF16 weight exponents 100..110 (finite products), per-lane coverage counters (non-zero BF16 and block-dot results required, BF16 skipped in THR).
